verdict.rationale: Gitea's docs confirm PR-based code review with reviewer comments and permission/ACL controls, and Actions for CI/CD, which together could underpin an approval gate before merge/production, but the evidence pack never mentions explicit branch-protection rules, required-approval enforcement, or status-check gating tied to deployment. missing for 10: explicit branch protection/required-reviewer enforcement docs, CI status-check gating tied to merge, and any independent confirmation of these controls in production use.
